ينتهبان (form VIII)
# يَنْتَهِبَانِ (yantahibāni) /jan.ta.hi.baː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past active indicative of اِنْتَهَبَ (intahaba)
# يُنْتَهَبَانِ (yuntahabāni) /jun.ta.ha.baː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَهَبَ (intahaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
